scenarios.description: A self-evident response remains with the coordinator.
scenarios.request: Explain the supplied one-line constant.

expected.behavior: Skip workflow loading.

scenarios.description: One visible specialist can complete a narrow operation.
scenarios.request: Use the named document skill to read this document.

expected.behavior: Route only to the explicit specialist.

scenarios.description: An authorized implementation with tests uses the software workflow.
scenarios.request: Implement the approved parser change and add regression tests.

expected.behavior: Bound scope, implement, review, verify, and report.

scenarios.description: Cause finding without repair authority is not a software change.
scenarios.request: Explain why the service crashes; do not modify anything.

expected.behavior: Keep investigation read-only.

scenarios.description: An evidence-backed causal explanation uses diagnosis.
scenarios.request: Diagnose why requests intermittently time out without changing state.

expected.behavior: Test distinct hypotheses and preserve uncertainty.

scenarios.description: A known cause with an authorized repair is not diagnosis-led.
scenarios.request: The null check is missing; add it and test the fix.

expected.behavior: Use the authorized change workflow.

scenarios.description: A comparison and recommendation uses research and decision.
scenarios.request: Compare the three storage options and recommend one with evidence.

expected.behavior: Normalize evidence and calibrate the recommendation.

scenarios.description: Research that only supports a requested artifact is artifact-led.
scenarios.request: Research the audience and create the final presentation.

expected.behavior: Treat research as an artifact-creation stage.

scenarios.description: A substantial rendered deliverable uses artifact creation.
scenarios.request: Create and visually verify the final PDF report.

expected.behavior: Brief, create, render, inspect, revise, and report.

scenarios.description: A trivial specialist-owned artifact operation keeps the fast path.
scenarios.request: Rename the supplied document title.

expected.behavior: Use the owning specialist without loading a workflow.

scenarios.description: Unknown cause is a bounded stage of the authorized software deliverable.
scenarios.request: Find the cause, then implement and verify the authorized fix.

expected.behavior: Use one software workflow with diagnosis as a stage.

scenarios.description: Documentation supporting one software outcome stays in its lead workflow.
scenarios.request: Implement the feature and update its usage documentation.

expected.behavior: Treat supporting documentation as part of the software deliverable.

scenarios.description: Independent software and publication deliverables compose two workflows.
scenarios.request: Ship the code change and separately deliver a polished executive PDF with its own acceptance criteria.

expected.behavior: Compose distinct lead workflows through the intent DAG and explicit join.

scenarios.description: An explicit compatible skill remains the mandatory owner.
scenarios.request: Use the explicitly named PDF skill to create the report.

expected.behavior: Preserve explicit skill ownership inside the selected workflow.

scenarios.description: Unavailable required capability is not simulated.
scenarios.request: Create an artifact in a format for which no visible capability exists.

expected.behavior: Use a safe fallback, clarify, or block without simulating the capability.

scenarios.description: A failed evidence lane remains visible at the join.
scenarios.request: One research worker failed while other lanes returned useful evidence.

expected.behavior: Continue only if useful and preserve the failed lane and affected criteria.

scenarios.description: Exhausted execution budget stops further orchestration.
scenarios.request: The selected workflow has exhausted its branch budget.

expected.behavior: Stop and report the evidence collected within budget.

scenarios.description: A bounded review loop stops when another round adds no material progress.
scenarios.request: The last review round produced no material improvement.

expected.behavior: Stop the loop and report unresolved findings.

scenarios.description: Missing mutation authority blocks before action.
scenarios.request: Apply a software change without any stated mutation authority.

expected.behavior: Stop at the authority gate with AUTHORITY_REQUIRED.

scenarios.description: An explicit prohibition cannot be cured by workflow selection.
scenarios.request: Modify a protected path that higher-priority instructions forbid changing.

expected.behavior: Block with AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN before mutation; a human gate cannot cure a prohibition.

scenarios.description: A changed selected workflow version invalidates packet freshness.
scenarios.request: Continue from a packet whose workflow catalog marker no longer matches when rebuilding inputs are unavailable.

expected.behavior: Rebuild before handoff or stop with STALE_PACKET if rebuilding is unavailable.

scenarios.description: A v1 packet is never silently interpreted as v2.
scenarios.request: Resume using an everyskill.route/v1 packet when the latest canonical request and current authority or catalog inputs are unavailable for rebuilding.

expected.behavior: Reject incompatible packet semantics.

scenarios.description: A v1 packet can proceed only after rebuilding a fresh v2 packet.
scenarios.request: For the currently authorized request to implement the parser change and regression tests, rebuild the old v1 packet from the current request, authority, and catalogs.

expected.behavior: Rebuild v2 and then continue from current truth sources.
